description: Cost routing for a paid 3P deployment where the main thread often runs on Opus or Fable. Three single-PowerShell wirings. (1) note-model on SessionStart: records the payload's model field to <plugin data>/<session_id>/model.txt and emits nothing (zero context tokens; one short launch per session open, resume, or compaction). (2) route-check on UserPromptSubmit: reads that file (falling back to the transcript tail, then to unknown) and injects a short additionalContext ONLY when the session is on Opus or Fable or the tier is unknown; the note always tells the model to confirm against the Model: line in its own env block. First injection per session is the full digest (~110 tokens), later ones a one-line reminder (~25 tokens); on Sonnet or Haiku nothing is injected. (3) spawn-gate on PreToolUse:Agent: logs every Agent spawn's subagent_type and model to routing.log (plugin data and the exported session dir) and returns permissionDecision ask when a spawn requests Opus or Fable, since the only workers here run on Sonnet and Haiku. Disable routing with EPLUS_NO_MODEL_ROUTING=1; disable the gate (logging stays) with EPLUS_ALLOW_EXPENSIVE_SPAWN=1. All scripts always exit 0; decisions travel in the JSON body.
